svg.title: Copilot Chat: Work vs Web Toggle
svg.desc: A user asks Copilot Chat. With the Work toggle, Copilot Chat searches Microsoft Graph: emails, docs, Teams and calendar. With the Web toggle, it searches Bing, the public internet.
svg.text: Copilot Chat: Work vs Web Toggle
The toggle decides whether Copilot searches your org data or the public web.
